text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has come once again. This
time last
year, Кинг Хало was in the
midst of the Classic
Triple Crown tour,
but now she's focused only on
her own
path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик approaches and asks
which race
Кинг Хало plans to run in
next, but the
conversation is interrupted
and the two promise
to speak again
later.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps a new fire has been lit by their
paths
diverging. In any case, they remain
rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
